about: Fort St. John is a city in northeastern British Columbia’s Peace River Country, a service hub for oil, gas, and agriculture on the Alaska Highway. Prairie-parkland surrounds a growing commercial centre that supplies camps and farms across the North Peace. It sits well north of Prince George along the highway corridor. About 21,000 people live in Fort St. John.
